description: Replaces the Jellyfin web client's own rendering with a Nuvio lookalike, backed entirely by remote sources through Gelato. No local media is assumed. Own auth/session runtime and directly rendered screens, not a reskin of native jellyfin-web components.
name: Jellio
overview: Replaces the Jellyfin web client's own rendering with a Nuvio lookalike.

versions.changelog:
## [1.109.1] - 2026-11-11

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- *(offline)* Cache the page and the scripts of the first visit so an offline start works
- *(offline)* Load the screens that work offline while still online
- *(syncplay)* Open Jellyfin's WebSocket with ApiKey so servers without legacy auth accept it
- *(syncplay)* Install the WebSocket ApiKey fix before anything opens a socket
- *(player)* Open a title while in a group whose queue is not known yet, and wire the media session after its state exists

### 📚 Documentation

- Add 1.109.1 release notes to What's New changelog

## [1.109.0] - 2026-11-10

### 🚀 Features

- *(player)* Add hover and drag timestamp preview on scrubber
- Add reverse stream handoff and subtitle style sync
- *(playback)* Add play-start telemetry endpoint and admin stats
- *(playback)* Send play-start timings from the web player
- *(api)* Serve normalized skip segments at /Jellio/segments/{itemId}
- *(player)* Load skip segments from the server's merged segments endpoint

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- *(offline)* Prevent false offline detection and auto-restore previous route on reconnect
- *(web)* Confirm a 401 before signing the user out
- *(web)* Match stream languages across all ISO 639 codes
- *(web)* Translate release-date labels and seasonal row titles
- *(web)* Only open http(s) links and escape CSS url() values
- *(syncplay)* Judge Pause drift against the commanded position
- *(player)* Translate player toasts and playback errors
- *(web)* Escape the remaining CSS url() values in the player, hero and notifications
- *(player)* Apply start over and carried-over positions before negotiating the stream
- *(web)* Pull recommendation genres from the server on start and in Settings
- *(player)* Never read a backwards frame count as a silent slideshow
- *(syncplay)* Keep the position on a Pause that carries none
- *(syncplay)* Start Group Watch once Jellyfin's ApiClient exists and keep its sign-in in line with Jellio's

### 📚 Documentation

- Add 1.109.0 release notes to What's New changelog

### ⚡ Performance

- *(core)* Pause now-playing polling when hidden and align assembly version to 1.0.0.0
- *(web)* Compress frontend assets at the smallest size and send Vary: Accept-Encoding
- *(web)* Raise the startup request cap on HTTP/2 connections
- *(web)* Cache the display language and fill t() placeholders without RegExp
- *(boot)* Modulepreload the stored display language table from the early inline script
- *(web)* Keep the full changelog out of the notification poll
- *(boot)* Load seasons, SyncPlay, the mini player, onboarding, stream picker and downloads on first use
- *(boot)* Start the first data requests alongside the server ping
- *(web)* Serve versioned assets cache-first and let images bypass the service worker
- *(web)* Request card images at display size times pixel ratio
- *(boot)* Stop loading the Cast SDK on every page, runtime/cast.js loads it with the player
- *(web)* Pause the hero and coverflow rotation while the tab is hidden
- *(web)* Resize seasonal canvases at most once per frame
- *(web)* Make row scroll handling passive and stop measuring layout on every scroll event
- *(player)* Negotiate playback alongside item details and ask for the audio language up front
- *(playback)* Prefetch PlaybackInfo while resting on Play on the title page
- *(player)* Start Ready and local direct-play streams after 2 s of buffer
- *(player)* Hand the next-episode preload to the next player

### 🚜 Refactor

- *(web)* Drop client-side watchlist auto-removal
- *(web)* Split runtime/api.js into runtime/api/ modules behind a barrel
- *(web)* Route hand-built authenticated fetches through authedFetch
- *(web)* Read and write localStorage through runtime/storage.js
- *(web)* Share clock and file size formatters through runtime/format.js
- *(web)* Break the recommend cycle and stop screens importing home.js
- *(web)* Add a teardown scope for screen timers, listeners and observers
- *(web)* Move self-contained player clusters into components/player
- *(web)* Drop the unused saveServerDisplayLanguage
- *(player)* Add the skip segment rules as a pure module
- *(player)* Run the skip rules from runtime/skipSegments.js

### 🧪 Testing

- Add shared web/TV test vectors

### ⚙️ Miscellaneous Tasks

- *(changelog)* Sync 0.7.1 release notes for macOS
- *(api)* Remove five endpoints nothing calls
- *(web)* Drop unused imports
- *(web)* Drop the non-streaming manga search fallback

using recSeen and do not block items in catalog or genre rows. Implement
